name: desktop_move_mouse
description: Move the mouse pointer to an absolute screen pixel (x, y). Grounding comes from desktop_look or desktop_a11y — pass their coordinates straight through.

name: desktop_click_mouse
description: Click a mouse button at an absolute screen pixel (x, y). button is left|right|middle (default left); clickCount 2 for a double-click. A logged-in desktop click can submit forms and confirm purchases — treat it as an external, irreversible action.

name: desktop_press_mouse
description: Press or release a mouse button at an absolute screen pixel, for building custom drags. press is down|up. button is left|right|middle (default left).

press.description: Whether to press down or release.

name: desktop_drag_mouse
description: Drag the mouse along a path of absolute screen pixels with a button held. path is an array of {x, y} points from start to end. button is left|right|middle (default left).

name: desktop_scroll
description: Scroll the mouse wheel at an absolute screen pixel. direction is up|down|left|right; scrollCount is the number of wheel steps (default 3).

name: desktop_type_text
description: Type a string of text into the focused element, character by character. Click the target field first so it holds focus.

name: desktop_paste_text
description: Paste a string of text into the focused element in one shot (faster than typing for long text).

name: desktop_type_keys
description: Press one or more keys together as a chord (e.g. ["ctrl","c"] to copy, ["Return"] to submit, ["alt","Tab"] to switch windows). Use X keysym names.

keys.description: Keys to press together (X keysym names).

name: desktop_screenshot
description: Capture a screenshot of the whole desktop. The image is shown to the user automatically. For acting on elements prefer desktop_a11y (deterministic) or desktop_look (grounded coordinates) — a raw screenshot is for viewing.

name: desktop_cursor_position
description: Read the current mouse cursor position as absolute screen pixels {x, y}. A cheap read used to confirm the desktop is responsive.

name: desktop_wait
description: Wait a fixed number of milliseconds for the desktop to settle (a page to load, an animation to finish) before the next action.

name: desktop_application
description: Bring an application to the foreground on the desktop (launching it if needed). application is one of firefox, 1password, thunderbird, vscode, terminal, desktop, directory (file manager).

name: desktop_read_file
description: Read a file from inside the desktop's filesystem and return its contents (base64). Use for pulling a file the desktop produced (a download, a saved document).

name: desktop_write_file
description: Write a file into the desktop's filesystem. data is base64-encoded content. Use to place a file the desktop needs (an upload, a document to open).

path.description: Absolute path inside the desktop to write.
